gaps.note: The data sheet lists Rack Mount Kit 590054 in the box and Rack Tray Kit 590085 (to full-rack width) as an accessory, and describes the unit as half-rack width. No held document dimensions either kit or says where the ears sit, so no ear or kit is modelled.
gaps.wanted: The kit installation guide for 590054 and 590085.

gaps.note: The data sheet says "Dual Power inputs, second available as redundancy" and the Quick Start Guide says to connect a second power cable for redundancy, but the box holds one adapter and no document says whether the jacks are interchangeable or which one the adapter belongs in. Both are drawn as 12 VDC jacks.
gaps.wanted: A hardware guide that says what each jack feeds.

gaps.note: The data sheet calls the supply output a "locking barrel connector" and the photograph shows a locking nut on each jack, but no held document gives the barrel size or polarity. The part is the library's one nominal barrel jack, drawn without the nut.
gaps.wanted: A dimensioned drawing of the rear panel or the adapter plug.

gaps.note: The data sheet states "Less than 38W (130 BTU/h)" for the unit and no figure for any one jack, lamp or port, so none is stated for them.
Each switch jack shows two lamps in the photograph. No held document says what they mean, so the lamps keep the library's link and activity convention for an Ethernet jack.
gaps.wanted: A hardware guide that tables the switch jack lamps.

gaps.note: The Quick Start Guide, "Configure Local Console", says OM1300 appliances have one RJ45 serial console and one USB-C serial console. The front photograph and the data sheet show the USB-C console port only, so only that is placed.
gaps.wanted: A hardware guide that says whether an RJ45 console exists.

gaps.note: The rear photograph labels four gold jacks WWAN1 to WWAN4 and the data sheet lists SMA antennas (569060, 569061, 4x4 MiMo 4G/5G SMA), but no document names the jack on the unit, so SMA is read from the photograph.
gaps.wanted: A hardware guide that names the antenna jack.

gaps.note: The SIM slots and the 4FF tray are drawn from the photograph alone; no document dimensions either.
gaps.wanted: A drawing of the SIM slot or the tray 429020.

cellular.note: Data sheet: the -C models add a 5G cellular modem (Sierra Wireless EM9291, 5G NR Sub-6 and LTE CAT20); they are 189 mm deep and 1.65 kg, and ship with four cellular antennas (569052) and two 4FF SIM card trays (429020). Quick Start Guide: antenna ports and two SIM card slots on the rear; attach the antennas, put the cards in the trays and push the trays in until they click. The rear photograph labels the jacks WWAN1 to WWAN4 and the slots 1 and 2. The jacks are SMA by the photograph (gold hex nut, centre pin); no document names the connector.

chassis.note: Data sheet, Dimensions and Weight: cellular models 8.66 x 7 x 1.75 in, 220 x 189 x 44 mm, 1.65 kg. Form factor "Compact - SFF 1RU half-rack width". The rack kit 590054 ships in the box but no source dimensions it, so the body is drawn alone.

front-layout.note: Method: the OM1304-4E-C front photograph (2560 x 1440, straight on, no scale marker) is measured against the data sheet envelope by its transparent background: the body outline is 1293 px wide and 259 px high, 5.88 px/mm across from 220 mm and 5.89 px/mm down from 44 mm, so the face is orthographic to about 2 percent. Every position on the front is read off that photograph and is good to about 1 mm: the two SFP cages, the two RJ45 jacks, the serial block (pitch 13.97 across, rows 14.0 apart, the pitch of the library's ganged jack), the four-jack switch block, the two USB-A ports, the USB-C console, the erase pinhole, the six lamps and the printing. The serial and switch blocks are read on the front only.

lamps.note: Quick Start Guide, LED Panel: six LEDs, Power, Heartbeat, Network, IOIO, Cloud / Internet and Cellular Interface, each with its states. The photograph prints the power, heartbeat and network symbols over the top row and IOIO, an antenna and a cloud under the second row. The Cellular lamp is printed on every model, the standard ones included.

livery.note: The red and charcoal faces, the two diagonal stripes, the light label tabs and the wordmark are read off the photographs at the same scale and are painted livery, not parts. The logo mark is a simplified outline.

network.note: Data sheet: "2 x combo ports - RJ45 100BASE-TX/1000 BASE-T or SFP". The photograph prints NET1(S), NET2(S) over two stacked SFP cages and NET1(C), NET2(C) over two stacked RJ45 jacks, each jack with two lamps. The (S) and (C) halves of one number are one combo port; both halves are placed and share the number, the way the library draws other combo ports.

power.note: Data sheet: dual power inputs, the second available as redundancy; one universal 110-240 V AC to 12 V DC external adapter in the box (450047, 65 W, IEC C14 inlet), a 60 W 18-72 V DC kit (450050) as an accessory; consumption "Less than 38W (130 BTU/h)". The rear prints 12VDC under each jack. Quick Start Guide: connect a second power cable for redundancy; the power lamp is green for redundancy and amber for none.

rear-layout.note: Method as the front: the OM1304-4E-C rear photograph is 1225 px wide and 242 px high (5.57 and 5.5 px/mm), orthographic to about 2 percent. The two 12VDC jacks (centres 159.5 and 209.7 mm), the four SMA jacks (centres 30.0, 81.9, 133.9 and 186.1 mm, an even 52 mm pitch) and the two SIM slots (centres 24.3 and 47.3 mm) are read off it, good to about 1 mm.

serial.note: Data sheet: OM1304-4E-C has 4 RJ45 RS232 serial ports with a software selectable straight or rollover pinout, 50 to 115,200 bps. The pinout drawing prints the X2 "Cisco Straight" pins 1 CTS, 2 DSR/DCD, 3 RxD, 4 GND, 5 not connected, 6 TxD, 7 DTR, 8 RTS, and the X1 "Cisco Rolled" pins. The photograph numbers the ports 1 and 3 over 2 and 4, with SERIAL printed between the lower numerals.

serial-role.note: The serial ports are console server ports. Quick Start Guide, "Configure Serial Ports": "Mode: Console Server" is the default. The data sheet calls them "Managed Serial Ports" and the USB-C jack the "Local Console Port".

sides.note: No source shows the top, bottom or either side of the unit. Passive cooling is stated (data sheet) and the front and rear photographs show a row of vent openings along their top edge, drawn on those faces.

sources.note: Opengear OM1300 Operations Manager datasheet (September 22, 2026): model table, interfaces, power, cooling, dimensions and weight, package checklist and accessories. OM1300 Quick Start Guide v1 (September 2026): "In the Box" front and rear callouts, hardware installation steps, the LED panel table. The OM1304-4E-C front and rear photographs and the serial pinout drawing published with them.

switch.note: Data sheet: OM1304-4E-C lists 4 "Ethernet Switch Ports" in its model table; the Interfaces table says "4 x Managed 10/100/1000 Base-T switched Ethernet Ports". The photograph prints SWITCH between the lower numerals of 2 and 4 and draws 4 jacks, each with two lamps, which is what is placed. Quick Start Guide: the switch ports are bridged by default in an interface called "Switch".

usb.note: Data sheet: two USB 3.0 ports (mass storage, device console management) and one USB-C console port, default 9600 8N1. The photograph labels the two USB-A jacks A and B and prints the SuperSpeed mark under them.
